description: Land Acquisition - Kotubedda Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a declaration by the Minister that specific land described in detail (including location, boundaries, and extent) is needed for public purpose and will be acquired. The content focuses entirely on land matters, including property descriptions, boundaries, and acquisition procedures, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). While it mentions a government minister, the core content is about land acquisition rather than government structure or personnel changes.
